title: Monte Carlo simulation of the HXY model
action: Implement a Metropolis Monte Carlo simulation of the 2D harmonic XY (HXY) model on an L=32 square lattice with periodic boundary conditions, using J=1, T=0.5. Equilibrate for at least 2000 sweeps, then collect at least 10,000 independent magnetization samples per spin. Store the raw magnetization time series for later analysis.
description: Generate equilibrium spin configurations and extract the scalar magnetization time series. This simulation step produces the dataset required by the downstream scored moment analysis.

title: Magnetization moments and analytical spin‑wave predictions
action: From the magnetization samples collected in step_01, compute the thermal average <M>, variance σ², and skewness γ₁ = <(M−<M>)³>/σ³. Also compute the analytical spin‑wave predictions for the mean and susceptibility using the formulas from the paper (mean = (1/(2N))^{T/(8πJ)}, susceptibility = (1/(2·a_2D))·N·<M>²·T/J² with a_2D=258.6). Store all five quantities in magnetization_moments.json.
description: Scored artifact containing the Monte Carlo magnetization moments and the analytical spin‑wave predictions to be compared against reference recomputed values.
